items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: There was Charlie Parker, Dizzy Gillespie and the drummer with this -- what was the name of this guy? Max Roach.

ctx.x: Max Roach. That's the man's name. I got him here, and I got his (inaudible), but I couldn't get -- I couldn't sleep that night. I mean, they play so much stuff --
